description: Cancellations made before 21+ days check-in are eligible for 100% refund.
Any cancellations made before 14+days are eligible for 50% refund.
Any cancellations made 14 days or lesser towards the booking date are not eligible for refund.

In case of extreme last-minute cancellations due to extenuating circumstances, Guests will be refunded 85% of booking amount if SaffronStays gets another booking for the same date(s). If not, Guests will not be given a refund, and the cancellation will be treated as a no-show.
If the Guest has made a partial payment, they are entitled to no refund whatsoever.
During peak travel periods and holidays, cancellation and modification terms may vary slightly due to high demand. We recommend reviewing the applicable cancellation policy at the time of booking.
